limitations: Each reported timing profile has two independent hosted Windows VM strata; different scopes can use different VMs. Confidence intervals are conditional on these observed strata, not a physical-hardware diversity guarantee.
Compile-off and BC cold/hot use 5 measured pairs per VM; incremental first/hot and complete BIG use 3 per VM. Warmup excluded, no outlier deletion.
OS file cache warmed; every timed compiler is a new process. BC-cold does not mean cold disk, cold OS pages or a retained warm JIT.
Provided 194 .asset input files retained in the complete historical MOD, independently of newly generated BC/SC state.
Whole-MOD new SC rejects Texture explicitly; maps-session timings cover only the original metadata subset.
Full BIG gate compares complete member sets and every member payload plus exact SKUDEF bytes, not whole container identity.

Original cross-step inherited CI environment confounds incremental baselines and new recovery observations; those groups excluded from formal statistics in favor of verified fixed-environment followup.
Original observer-collection BIG layout excluded in favor of direct BAB output packaging. Failed PowerShell initialization run 40725824993 contains no timing samples.
CPU sums sequential compiler/tool processes, peak working set is the maximum individual process peak; not a whole-tree or whole-system memory measurement.
Old tools run with temporary absolute search paths and CLR4 legacy-v2 activation config; original EXE/DLL bytes unchanged. No inference about CLR2 environments.
Cache damage targets the largest supported payload of each engine, not the same resource type; new Texture BC and full Texture SC are unavailable. Recovery observations do not prove all asset types.
Retry after damage restores a known healthy cache backup. Backup-copy cost excluded; it is not timed clear-cache repair. Empty-cache construction is separately measured by BC-cold.
No game runtime acceptance or AssetMerge integration; production compiler unchanged. Full raw artifacts retained 30 days, persistent compact measurements do not replace expired payload bytes.
